fact: The Ministry of Youth and Sports signed an MoU with MyRide Technologies and SoulCode for a national digital-capacity programme to train about 40,000 young people (36,000 in digital literacy, 3,660 in advanced-technology bootcamps), piloting in five provinces.
The World Bank says the Mozambique Digital Acceleration Project, under implementation in the country, has promotion of digital skills among its priorities.

The ITU-EU VaMoz Digital project, sponsored by Mozambique's Ministry of Communications and Digital Transformation, ran a Matola pilot training programme that trained 50 youth and 5 teachers, after a National Digital Skills Assessment.

The EU's 2026 annual action plan document for Mozambique describes a Team Europe action, part of the Digital Economy Package signed between Mozambique and the EU, to enhance digital literacy and skills development through establishing and operationalizing Multimedia Community Centres (CMCs), building on the VaMoz Digital! tech hubs in Nampula and Zambezia.
